name: Thetanuts
summary: Thetanuts IndexVault.mint() computes each required component-vault transfer with truncating integer division and accepts zero amounts. After claiming flash-borrowed index shares reduced totalSupply to three, the attacker made 37 sub-supply mints whose component transfers all rounded to zero, reminted the shares needed to repay Aave, and kept the five component-vault balances.

loss.notes: The exploit receipt measures exact net proceeds of 105,471.499078 USDC plus 33,593.775337 residual AVAXUSD, BNBUSD, and MATICUSD component-vault shares. Gross IndexVault depletion was also exact: 49,716.431047 BTCUSD, 23,955.277333 ETHUSD, and those three residual balances. The attacker disposed of the BTCUSD and ETHUSD shares through initWithdraw to obtain the USDC; the USD total uses those realised proceeds and conservatively excludes the unvalued residual shares. The approximately $2.1 million cited for the incident was value at risk, not realised loss, because a whitehat rescued approximately $2 million.

ageReset.description: The top-level CREATE installed the direct 12,494-byte IndexVault runtime containing claim() and mint(); its runtime hash is unchanged immediately before the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful anchor receipt and call trace, commit-pinned reproduction, component-token metadata and balances, direct creation transaction, and historical runtime. Existing attack contract 0x0f9daa9e0adced4e64578b2e131930dde54e492e calls IndexVault 0xc2c3ae0a7b405058558c9b4a63b373486cb86ac7 claim(uint256) once, leaving totalSupply at three, then calls mint(uint256) 37 times while each required component transfer rounds to zero. Transfer logs show the IndexVault losing exactly 49,716.431047 BTCUSD, 23,955.277333 ETHUSD, 6,378.688541 AVAXUSD, 17,186.382409 BNBUSD, and 10,028.704387 MATICUSD component shares. The attacker converts the BTCUSD and ETHUSD shares and forwards exactly 105,471.499078 USDC plus all three residual share balances to 0xaf3a0fdbfb0e3127247b66a042310e09c32f2299. Transaction 0x5fe942c5d09bd3b427c5d8c0ecabd0d2468d4452b0b7f32f87ca358c0c997132 creates the target directly from 0x4a4c7c5549359b9fff0137bb3ec4d48c4aa79cc7; its 12,494-byte runtime hashes to 0x510db13e39e464d3ed6b98a9e866666bd0bcfbccd37c9b26d0590c9349b9792a at both block 14668794 and block 25323328.

limitations: The comparable USD total conservatively excludes 33,593.775337 residual component-vault shares whose incident-time value was not independently established.
